v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Make a joyful noise * before the Lord our King.
Lord, * thou hast been our refuge. ‡
O Lord, * thy mercy is in heaven.

text.la: Pópulus meus, * ait Dóminus, bonis meis adimplébitur.
text.en: My people, * said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.
To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

text.la: Mulíerem fortem quis invéniet? Procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius. Confídit in ea cor viri sui, et spóliis non indigébit.
text.en: Who shall find a valiant woman? Far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her. The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Date ei * de fructu mánuum suárum, et laudent eam in portis ópera eius.
text.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands, * and let her own works praise her in the gates.

text.la: Tuórum corda fidélium, Deus miserátor, illústra: et, beátæ Elísabeth précibus gloriósis; fac nos próspera mundi despícere, et cælésti semper consolatióne gaudére.
text.en: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of thy faithful people, and by the glorious prayers of thy blessed handmaid Elizabeth, make us to set little store by the good things of this world, and to rejoice ever in thy heavenly comfort.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Pontiánum Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Pontianus thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
